description: This file defines a PHP class `EAPMViewEdit` which extends `ViewEdit` and manages the edit view for EAPM (External Account Password Management) settings in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for setting return IDs, generating module titles, and displaying the view with access control.

classes.name: EAPMViewEdit
classes.description: A class extending ViewEdit that manages the editing interface for EAPM entries, including user return ID logic, title parameters, and display control.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object and sets the return ID.

methods.name: setReturnId
methods.description: Sets the return ID based on current user or request parameters.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the module tab, fixed as 'Users'.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Generates parameters for the module title, including icons and return links.

methods.name: getModuleTitleIconPath
methods.description: Returns the icon path for the 'Users' module.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Prepares data for rendering the edit view, including password handling and access control.
